verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers several machine-readable ways to discover what it provides. A connected MCP client can programmatically load all available tools. Each app has its own dedicated MCP server. A probed llms.txt app-marketplace index lists the catalog of 3,223 apps, and per-app .md pages give tool counts. However, no documented queryable registry/catalog API (search or filter endpoints for servers and tools) is shown; the REST API is described only generically as interacting with the Connect service. missing for 10: a documented catalog/registry query endpoint with search or filter, API reference for listing apps/servers and their tools, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically

citations.quote: tools: await mcpClient.tools(), // Automatically loads all available tools
Each app has its own dedicated MCP server with tools specific to that API.
Pipedream Connect provides managed auth, MCP servers, and API tooling for 3,223
